Title: Vercel SPA Deep-Link 404 Routing Failure
ReproductionSteps: Directly visit https://indraprasth-uniforms.vercel.app/shop or /cart or reload any subpage
Evidence: curl -I https://indraprasth-uniforms.vercel.app/shop -> HTTP/1.1 404 Not Found (X-Vercel-Error: NOT_FOUND)
Impact: Every direct visit, reload, bookmark, or social share to subpages breaks with a 404 error. Zero product pages crawlable.
RecommendedFix: Update vercel.json rewrite destination for /(.*) to route to /index.html in the client service.

Title: Hardcoded Production MongoDB Atlas URI & Password in Source Code
ReproductionSteps: Inspect server/src/config/env.ts line 24 and server/src/scripts/verify-pdf-sample.py line 12
Evidence: Line 24: mongodb+srv://Vercel-Admin-atlas-bole-candle:a40i7Bz1r66uSegK@... committed in commit 0c6d940
Impact: Full database compromise: anyone with repo read access can access, dump, tamper, or wipe live MongoDB Atlas data.
RecommendedFix: Remove fallback default string; require process.env.MONGODB_URI; rotate Atlas credentials immediately.

Title: Production Database Backup with Admin Password Hashes Committed to Git
ReproductionSteps: Inspect git repository tracking for backups/ directory
Evidence: admins.json committed in commit 685849d containing admin@indraprasth.com and bcrypt hash $2a$12$rl8Xvig1...
Impact: Credential exposure: offline dictionary/brute-force attacks against bcrypt hash; exposes internal admin IDs and emails.
RecommendedFix: Add backups/ and import/ to .gitignore; remove files from git cache; rotate admin credentials.

Title: Overly Permissive CORS with Wildcard Vercel Domain & SameSite None
ReproductionSteps: Send request to API with Origin: https://evil-attacker.vercel.app and Cookie: token=...
Evidence: CORS check origin.endsWith('.vercel.app') returns true; allows credentials: true; sameSite: 'none'
Impact: Cross-Site Request Forgery (CSRF): any third-party app hosted on Vercel can forge authenticated mutations against admin endpoints.
RecommendedFix: Restrict CORS origin to exact domain IU_CLIENT_URL; require CSRF token / custom headers for state-changing requests.

Title: Variant Order Cancellation Stock Restoration Failure
ReproductionSteps: Place order on variant product (e.g. Billabong Purple T-Shirt), then patch status to cancelled
Evidence: Code executes Product.updateOne({'sizes.label': item.size}, {$inc: {'sizes.$.stock': item.qty}}); matches 0 docs for variants
Impact: Inventory drift: cancelled orders for any of the 23 variant products lose inventory count permanently and undercount available stock.
RecommendedFix: Update cancel handler to check if product has variants and use arrayFilters on variants.$[v].sizes.$[s].stock.

Title: CSV Formula Injection in Admin Order Export
ReproductionSteps: Place order with name '=cmd|\' /C calc\'!A0' and export CSV via /api/v1/admin/orders/export.csv
Evidence: json2csv Parser parses raw unescaped values into CSV file without prefixing formula triggers
Impact: Remote Code Execution / spreadsheet compromise when an administrator opens the order CSV in MS Excel or LibreOffice.
RecommendedFix: Prefix any string starting with '='
column12: '@' with a single quote (') before JSON2CSV parsing.

Title: Unoptimized 9.1MB Hero Video Auto-Downloaded on Mobile
ReproductionSteps: Load homepage on mobile device with Slow 4G emulation
Evidence: curl -I /new-video-hero.mp4 -> 9,115,664 bytes (9.12 MB); video tag has preload='auto' and motion-reduce:hidden
Impact: Wasted cellular data and CPU bandwidth on mobile; slow page interaction and battery drain on slow connections.
RecommendedFix: Provide 720p/1080p responsive sources; use preload='metadata'; add IntersectionObserver and visibilitychange listeners.

Title: Missing Magic Byte File Validation on Image/Video Uploads
ReproductionSteps: Upload non-image file with Content-Type: image/png header to /api/v1/admin/uploads/image
Evidence: upload.ts fileFilter only validates file.mimetype from HTTP header; no buffer magic byte check
Impact: MIME-spoofing and potential malicious file ingestion onto CDN/storage.
RecommendedFix: Integrate 'file-type' npm package to inspect first 4100 bytes of buffer for valid image/video magic headers.

Title: Order Tracking Authentication Bypass via Non-Numeric Phone Padding
ReproductionSteps: Send tracking request with orderNumber and phone='abcdefghij'
Evidence: cleanPhone = phone.replace(/\D/g, '') yields empty string; regex '' + '$' matches any customer phone number
Impact: Unauthorized access to order details: any user with an orderNumber can view customer details without knowing their phone.
RecommendedFix: Enforce exact /^\d{10}$/ regex on phone input in orderTrackQuerySchema.

Title: Database Blob Bloat (280 Inline Base64 Images Across 92% of Catalog)
ReproductionSteps: Inspect images array in MongoDB products collection
Evidence: CLOUDINARY_API_KEY unset; 280 images across 100/108 products stored as data:image/jpeg;base64 strings in MongoDB Atlas
Impact: Excessive database payload size (multi-MB per API response), broken CDN caching, high network latency.
RecommendedFix: Configure production Cloudinary credentials and run migration script to upload images to Cloudinary.

Title: Order Reactivation Fails with Error on Variant Products
ReproductionSteps: Attempt to reactivate cancelled order containing variant products
Evidence: reactivateOrder checks sizes.label on root doc; fails and throws 'Cannot reactivate order: insufficient stock'
Impact: Administrators cannot reactivate cancelled variant orders; triggers false inventory errors.
RecommendedFix: Add variant size matching check in reactivateOrder identical to order creation.

Title: 8 Known CVE Vulnerabilities in Dependencies (2 Critical RCEs)
ReproductionSteps: Run npm audit on root workspace
Evidence: tinypool <=2.1.1 (Critical RCE: GHSA-5gmw-xhrv-c9v3), zod <4.6.6 (High DoS), esbuild/vite, react-router
Impact: Security exposure to prototype pollution and remote code execution in test/build pipelines and memory exhaustion DoS.
RecommendedFix: Run npm audit fix and update vitest

Title: Duplicate Product Record for DPS Neelbad White School Shorts Boys
ReproductionSteps: Query products collection with name /DPS Neelbad White School Shorts Boys/i
Evidence: Two distinct records found: productNo 86 (slug: ...shorts-boys) and productNo 101 (slug: ...shorts-boys-alt), both ₹520
Impact: Duplicate catalog entry creates customer confusion and splits inventory tracking across two distinct SKUs.
RecommendedFix: Deduplicate the two records in MongoDB and re-assign any order references to productNo 86.

Title: Inconsistent Variant Color Name Casing & Non-Standard Size Labels
ReproductionSteps: Inspect unique colorNames and sizes in products collection
Evidence: Colors: ['YELLOW', 'yellow', 'Yellow', 'BLUE', 'blue', 'Red', 'red']; Sizes: ['6th to 12th', 'Free Size']
Impact: Filtering by color yields fragmented facet results; '6th to 12th' is not a garment size and breaks size selection.
RecommendedFix: Run migration script to normalize colorNames to Title Case and standardise school age ranges into proper garment sizes.

Title: SEO Misconfiguration: Netlify URL Leftovers and Incomplete Sitemap
ReproductionSteps: client/public/sitemap.xml
Evidence: Inspect robots.txt, sitemap.xml and meta tags on https://indraprasth-uniforms.vercel.app/
Impact: robots.txt and sitemap.xml point to https://indraprasth-uniforms.netlify.app/; 0 products in sitemap; only 2/7 schools
RecommendedFix: Search engine indexing failure: crawlers index outdated Netlify staging domain and miss 108 products and 5 schools.
Effort: Update canonical domain to production Vercel URL; generate dynamic sitemap including all 108 products and 7 schools.

Title: Content Security Policy (CSP) & Security Headers Disabled
ReproductionSteps: Inspect HTTP response headers via curl -I on server API and Vercel frontend
Evidence: app.use(helmet({ contentSecurityPolicy: false })); Live frontend lacks X-Frame-Options and CSP
Impact: Clickjacking and XSS defense-in-depth failure; allows UI redressing in malicious iframes.
RecommendedFix: Enable Helmet CSP with strict directives; configure Vercel headers for X-Frame-Options: DENY and CSP.

Title: High API Latency on Browse Endpoint (p50: 1614ms
ReproductionSteps: server/src/controllers/productController.ts:157
Evidence: Measure response time of GET /api/v1/products/browse?limit=12 over 15 iterations
Impact: Browse latency: p50: 1614ms, p95: 2168ms, max: 2168ms; single $facet runs 8 sub-pipelines over cloud Atlas
RecommendedFix: Slow filtering and catalogue browsing experience for end users.
Effort: Cache facet counts with short TTL or separate metadata query; optimize aggregation pipelines with index hints.

Title: Missing API Health Check Endpoint on /api/v1/health
ReproductionSteps: Send GET request to /api/v1/health
Evidence: Returns HTTP 404 Route not found: GET /api/v1/health; only /health and /api/health are registered
Impact: Monitoring agents configured against API base /api/v1 fail health checks.
RecommendedFix: Add /api/v1/health to the registered health routes list in app.ts.

Title: Ghost 8th School ('STJ') with 0 Products Displays Counter '8' on Storefront
ReproductionSteps: client/src/components/home/SchoolRail.tsx:51
Evidence: Inspect schools in database and SchoolRail count badge on storefront
Impact: Database contains STJ (St. Joseph's Co-Ed School) with 0 products; SchoolRail badge shows count '8'
RecommendedFix: Customer confusion: clicking STJ displays an empty catalog with 0 products.
Effort: Hide schools with 0 active products from public SchoolRail or add items for STJ.

Title: Missing Staff Management & Deficient RBAC (Staff Can Delete Entities)
ReproductionSteps: Inspect admin routes and role middlewares
Evidence: No staff CRUD routes or UI page exist; DELETE /products, /schools, /categories do not check requireRole('owner')
Impact: Privilege escalation: staff accounts have excessive destructive permissions without oversight.
RecommendedFix: Implement staff management page; add requireRole('owner') to all entity deletion and CSV import routes.

Title: Deactivated Account Information Disclosure (User Enumeration)
ReproductionSteps: Submit login request with email of a deactivated account
Evidence: Returns HTTP 403 'Your account has been deactivated' before checking password; non-existent email returns 401
Impact: User enumeration: attacker can verify whether specific email addresses belong to admin accounts.
RecommendedFix: Return generic 'Invalid email or password' for deactivated accounts or check password before account status.

Title: Stateless 8-Hour JWT Tokens Cannot Be Revoked on Logout
ReproductionSteps: Inspect logout endpoint implementation
Evidence: logout only clears browser cookie; JWT tokens are signed for 8h with zero blacklist or token version check
Impact: Session hijacking: an intercepted or stolen JWT token remains valid for 8 hours even after user logs out.
RecommendedFix: Implement token blacklisting in memory/Redis or add tokenVersion field to Admin schema to invalidate on logout.

Title: Deprecated Netlify URL Hardcoded in Home.tsx JSON-LD Schema
ReproductionSteps: Inspect ClothingStore JSON-LD script tag in Home.tsx
Evidence: url: 'https://indraprasth-uniforms.netlify.app' hardcoded inside JSON-LD payload
Impact: Search engines associate structured business data with deprecated Netlify staging domain.
RecommendedFix: Update JSON-LD url property to https://indraprasth-uniforms.vercel.app/.

Title: 105 Interactive Touch Targets Below 44x44px Minimum Size
ReproductionSteps: Inspect interactive elements with Chrome DevTools at 320px/360px viewport
Evidence: 105 interactive elements fail 44x44px; mobile menu toggle is 40x40px, size chips are 24x22px, admin table buttons 32x32px
Impact: Tapping errors and frustration for mobile users with motor impairments or large fingers.
RecommendedFix: Add min-w-[44px] min-h-[44px] classes and touch padding to mobile buttons

Title: Color Contrast Ratio Failure on Strikethrough Pricing (3.86:1)
ReproductionSteps: Run Lighthouse on desktop/mobile homepage or inspect .text-taupe-500
Evidence: Lighthouse score 0 on color-contrast: #8C7B63 on #FBF8F2 yields 3.86:1 (< 4.5:1 required)
Impact: Low-vision users cannot easily read strikethrough original prices on product cards.
RecommendedFix: Darken --color-taupe-500 from #8C7B63 to #766650 to achieve 4.7:1 contrast ratio.

Title: Label-in-Name Mismatch on 'Add to Bag' and 'Filters' Buttons
ReproductionSteps: Inspect accessible names of 'Add to Bag' and mobile 'Filters' buttons
Evidence: Visible text 'Add to Bag' has aria-label='Add DPS Winter Tie to bag'; visible 'Filters' has aria-label='Open filter options'
Impact: Speech input users saying 'Click Add to Bag' fail because accessible name does not start with visible text.
RecommendedFix: Set aria-label to 'Add to Bag - DPS Winter Tie' so visible name matches beginning of accessible name.

Title: Unlabeled Admin Table Pagination Buttons
ReproductionSteps: Inspect ChevronLeft and ChevronRight pagination buttons in admin products table
Evidence: Buttons contain only SVG icons; no text, no title, no aria-label attribute
Impact: Screen reader users hear 'button' with no name or description of its purpose.
RecommendedFix: Add aria-label='Previous page' and aria-label='Next page' to pagination buttons.

Title: Missing Skip Navigation Link
ReproductionSteps: Attempt keyboard navigation with Tab on page load
Evidence: First tab stop focuses top banner link instead of a 'Skip to main content' anchor
Impact: Keyboard-only users must tab through 15+ header links on every single page navigation.
RecommendedFix: Add an accessible sr-only focus:not-sr-only skip link at the top of PublicLayout.

Title: 202 Typography Elements Rendered Under 12px Specification
ReproductionSteps: /shop
Evidence: Run computed style scan for elements with font-size < 12px
Impact: 202 elements render at 10px (discount badges) and 11px (school badges, cart counts)
RecommendedFix: Violates readability directive (nothing under 12px) and hinders legibility on high-DPI small screens.
Effort: Bump text-[10px] and text-[11px] classes to text-xs (12px) across badges

Title: Legacy Old Theme Color #1d4ed8 in Logo SVG
ReproductionSteps: Inspect fill attribute of client/public/logo.svg
Evidence: Line 2: <rect width='100' height='100' rx='20' fill='#1d4ed8'/>
Impact: Visual discrepancy if raw SVG is displayed or referenced instead of brand navy #0E2747.
RecommendedFix: Replace fill='#1d4ed8' with brand royal blue #1860A8 or navy #0E2747.

Title: Relative og:image and twitter:image URLs in index.html
ReproductionSteps: Inspect og:image and twitter:image meta tags in client/index.html
Evidence: Values are set to relative path '/og-image.png' instead of absolute canonical URL
Impact: Social media platforms (WhatsApp, Twitter, Facebook) fail to render preview cards.
RecommendedFix: Set og:image and twitter:image to full URL https://indraprasth-uniforms.vercel.app/og-image.png.

Title: Lack of Static Analysis (ESLint) and 110+ explicit ': any' Annotations
ReproductionSteps: Inspect package.json lint scripts and search for ': any' in TypeScript files
Evidence: npm run lint only executes tsc --noEmit; zero ESLint configuration; 110+ explicit ': any' types in codebase
Impact: Weak type safety and absence of automated code quality / security linting rules in CI/CD.
RecommendedFix: Add ESLint with typescript-eslint plugin and incrementally replace ': any' with strict types.
